summary: The save handler now preserves edits made while the request is pending, and a focused regression test verifies the selection remains dirty.

evidence: static/admin.js no longer overwrites modelsSelection after the save response, so later checkbox edits remain staged and unsaved.
tests/admin-models-catalog.test.ts adds a pending-response regression test asserting the later edit remains in modelsSelection and differs from modelsSavedSelection.
